Nilesoft Shell Pro 2.3.2 adds PowerShell 7 to the Terminal menu, adds two optional settings that make menus open faster, and translates the settings app's What's New page into more languages.

This version changes the Shell core, so updating from the app asks for administrator approval once.

**What's new**
- **PowerShell 7 in the Terminal menu.** When PowerShell 7 is installed, the Terminal menu offers it too. Press Shift or right-click it to run it as administrator. Thanks to speedlorenzo12 for asking (#21).
- **Faster menus, with two optional settings.** On the Behavior page of the app, *Get the menu ready when File Explorer starts* prepares Windows' menus in the background a few seconds after File Explorer starts, so the first right-click is quicker. *Keep other apps' menu items loaded* keeps what other programs load for their menu items, so right-clicks after a pause are quicker too. Keeping them loaded uses a little memory. Both are off unless you turn them on. Thanks to alchemyyy (#19).
- **The menu's language follows the app's.** Changing the language on the Preferences page now changes the language of the right-click menu too. It shows on the next right-click, with no restart of File Explorer. Auto still follows Windows.

**Fixes**
- The settings app's What's New page is translated into Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish and Arabic.
- Clicking an item in the settings app's sidebar no longer leaves a black box around it. The box still shows when you move through the sidebar with the keyboard.
- A new install opens at a size that shows the whole sidebar. Preferences has a *Reset window size and position* button if you want the default size back. Thanks to zhonglixun (#20).
